+        match = re.match(r'^no logging buffered (\S+)$', line)
+        if match and match.group(1) in LEVELS:
+            disabled.add(match.group(1))
+        elif re.match(r'^logging buffered(?:\s+\S+)?$', line):
+            buffered = True
+        elif re.match(r'^logging host (?:ipv6 )?\S+(?: udp-port \d+)?$', line):
+            result.append({'dest': 'host', 'name': parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                           'udp_port': parse_port(line, 'host'),
+                           'facility': None, 'level': None,
+                           'addr6': parse_address(line, 'host')})
+        elif line in ('logging console', 'logging persistence', 'logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[1]
+            result.append({'dest': dest, 'name': None, 'udp_port': None,
+                           'facility': None, 'level': None, 'addr6': False})
+    if buffered:
+        result.append({'dest': 'buffered', 'name': None, 'udp_port': None,
+                       'facility': None, 'level': set(LEVELS) - disabled,
+                       'addr6': False})
+    return result
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for item in lst:
+        if item.get('name') == name:
+            return item
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want) - set(have), set(have) - set(want)
+
+
+def _host_command(item, remove=False):
+    command = 'logging host '
+    if item.get('addr6'):
+        command += 'ipv6 '
+    command += item['name']
+    if item.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port ' + str(item['udp_port'])
+    return ('no ' if remove else '') + command
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for item in want:
+        dest = item['dest']
+        state = item['state']
+        facility = item.get('facility')
+        if facility is not None:
+            current = next((h['facility'] for h in have if h['dest'] == 'facility'), 'user')
+            command = None
+            if state == 'present' and facility != current:
+                command = 'logging facility ' + facility
+            elif state == 'absent' and facility == current and current != 'user':
+                command = 'no logging facility'
+            if command and command not in commands:
+                commands.append(command)
+        if dest == 'host':
+            candidates = [h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'host']
+            first = search_obj_in_list(item['name'], candidates)
+            hosts = [h for h in candidates if h['name'] == item['name'] and
+                     h['addr6'] == item['addr6']] if first else []
+            if state == 'present':
+                if not any(h['udp_port'] == item['udp_port'] for h in hosts):
+                    commands.append(_host_command(item))
+            else:
+                for host in hosts:
+                    if item['udp_port'] is None or item['udp_port'] == host['udp_port']:
+                        commands.append(_host_command(host, remove=True))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = next((h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'buffered'), None)
+            levels = current['level'] if current else set()
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(item['level'], levels)
+                for level in sorted(adds):
+                    commands.append('logging buffered ' + level)
+            elif current:
+                for level in sorted(item['level'] & levels):
+                    commands.append('no logging buffered ' + level)
+        elif dest in ('console', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on'):
+            present = any(h['dest'] == dest for h in have)
+            if (state == 'present' and not present) or (state == 'absent' and present):
+                base = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging ' + dest
+                commands.append(('no ' if state == 'absent' else '') + base)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS),
+        name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=LEVELS),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'], default='present'))
+    aggregate_spec = {key: dict(value) for key, value in element_spec.items()}
+    aggregate_spec['state'].pop('default')
+    argument_spec = dict(element_spec)
+    argument_spec.update(
+        aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+        check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                  fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=[('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                                   ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])])
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
